title: Character realizations of Schubert polynomials
statement: For each finite permutation \(w\), find a finite-dimensional polynomial representation, in a specified group category, whose torus character equals \(\mathfrak S_w\).
status: As of November 2026, the Borel-module formulation is solved by Kra\'skiewicz--Pragacz, in a 1986 preprint announced in 1987 and fully published in 2004. These modules need not be irreducible; the seminar does not specify a category for its stronger irreducibility wording. \citep[Theorem 4.1 and Introduction]{kraskiewiczpragacz2004schubert}

title: Real and complex representability of a finite matroid
statement: Given a finite matroid by its bases, determine whether it is representable over \(\mathbb R\) or over \(\mathbb C\).
status: As of November 2026, the finite decision problem is settled by polynomial encoding and quantifier elimination, available before 1987. The broader phrase classification is not made into a separate unresolved claim without a specified structural target. This is distinct from earlier problems on realization-space topology and determinant-sign isotopy. \citep[\S\S 2--3]{tarski1951decision}

title: Axiomatizing the nonzero-minor data of a bimatroid
statement: Characterize abstract collections \(\mathcal R\) of equally sized row-column subset pairs by axioms generalizing nonzero square minors.
status: As of November 2026, the collection is a bimatroid exactly when \(\{(E\setminus I)\sqcup J:(I,J)\in\mathcal R\}\) is a matroid basis family on \(E\sqcup F\) containing \(E\). The checked modern exposition attributes the theory to Kung 1978. \citep[Proposition 2.2]{rohrleulirsch2026bimatroids}

title: Information in a bimatroid beyond its row and column matroids
statement: Determine what data of a matrix bimatroid are lost when only its row matroid and column matroid are retained.
status: As of November 2026, the separate matroids do not determine the bimatroid; a two-by-two counterexample is given in the occurrence. Joint submatrix ranks, equivalently the nonzero square-minor pairs subject to bimatroid axioms, supply the missing data. \citep[Proposition 2.6]{rohrleulirsch2026bimatroids}

title: Generic irreducible Hecke characters in symmetric functions
statement: For the semisimple type-A Hecke algebra \(H_N(q)\), give a symmetric-function formula for irreducible character values on standard cycle elements \(T_{w_\mu}\).
status: As of November 2026, a Frobenius formula is available; Ram published one in 1991, and Halverson--Ram give the exact normalization and credit several independent discoveries. This is a generic-parameter answer and does not settle the different root-of-unity decomposition problem. \citep[equation (4.10), Theorem 4.11]{halversonram1999bitraces}
